applicability.reason: Dimensioned px/em/rem/% and non-literal calc()/var() values are never parsed as unitless leading, including 18px, 13px, 26px and 0.9rem.
CSS unitless number forms .9, 1., 1e0, 1.2, 1.2e0 are tight; 1.5, 1.6 and 1.5e0 meet the threshold; !important is supported.
Non-numeric CSS values are ignored without raising or manufacturing a unitless finding.
The deterministic readability warning remains for tight unitless leading and is absent for dimensional values.
The parser is a pure function and introduces no persistent or cross-call state.
The change only parses a supplied CSS string; it adds no inputs, storage, disclosure, or security-sensitive behavior.
The bounded regex scan is a local small-string classifier; this fix changes no algorithmic complexity or runtime profile.
The parser performs no network, provider, filesystem, billing, publishing, or deployment actions.
